public final class EtherFutureCalibrationScenarioHarness extends Object

EtherFutureCalibrationScenarioHarness

Dedicated scientific calibration harness and offline generator for the flagship Ether Biophysical Planetary Simulation (2025 CE - 2200 CE).

Design Principles:

  • Non-UI Internal Scenario: Deliberately excluded from the standard user scenario presets catalog.
  • Spatial Resolution: H3 Resolution $r = 4$ for high-precision regional biogeographical fidelity.
  • Temporal Resolution: Monthly step size $\Delta t = 30.0$ days.
  • Authentic T0 Initialization: Empirical 2024/2025 baseline seamlessly continued from ERA5, UN WPP 2024, and Maddison 2020.
  • Tier 2 Cliodynamic Engine Filter: Systematically activates all peer-reviewed contemporary/future Type B engines, while strictly excluding the 7 falsified/invalidated debate models (Malthusian Static Trap, Nordhaus DICE, Pinker Pacification, Scott Cereal Determinism, Hardin Unregulated Commons, Diamond Pure Geography, Psychohistory).
